name: kraken-cli
description: Unofficial CLI for Kraken cryptocurrency exchange
author: Tiago Morais

scripts.compile: bun build --compile --target=bun-linux-x64 src/index.ts --outfile dist/kraken-linux-x64 && bun build --compile --target=bun-darwin-arm64 src/index.ts --outfile dist/kraken-darwin-arm64 && bun build --compile --target=bun-windows-x64 src/index.ts --outfile dist/kraken-windows-x64.exe
